title: The gaming PC that costs less than your phone

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the gaming PC of tomorrow costs less than a basic smartphone — and performs just as well?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Modern GPUs and chipsets are shrinking, and modular designs allow for cheaper, more efficient systems than ever before.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If gaming PCs become affordable, will we see a surge in screen addiction or a widening gap in access to quality digital education?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are focusing on open-source hardware and standardized components to keep costs low without sacrificing performance.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where gaming and learning merge, with accessible tech empowering underprivileged youth through immersive education.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of computing may not be in the cloud — but in the hands of those who need it most.

video_cue: A compact, sleek gaming PC being assembled from modular parts, with a child playing an educational game on it.
